title: Motorboat Speeding on Open Ocean, 1960s B&W Vintage Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot capturing a small motorboat or patrol vessel cutting through choppy open sea water, creating a noticeable white wake behind it. In the hazy distance on the horizon, the faint silhouette of a larger vessel is visible beneath an overcast sky. The reverse side features a single stamped processing number '665E'.
